title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12000__PART_2_)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard prescribes the minimum overs that should be added to the base (printable) quantity of paper needed for a particular job to be printed through web offset machine. 1.2 This wastage formula may vary for paper below 45 gsm for web offset machine. 1.3 The wastage report details are based after monitoring the working of newspaper industry as well as publication houses having web offset machines.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
